delta_purpose: Net-new client records that were listed in the registry (unified_clients_registry.csv) but had no physical asset in v1.0. Merge these on top of the v1 pack to reach 17-client coverage.

canvas.note: Identical spec to v1 pack. Assets drop into any grid cell with aspect-ratio: 8/5 and object-fit: contain without per-logo adjustments.

file_pairing_convention.transparent_png: NN_slug.png (primary, RGBA, use everywhere transparency is supported)
file_pairing_convention.white_jpg: NN_slug_white.jpg (fallback on #ffffff for systems that cannot render transparency)

name.ar: المبادرة الوطنية لتطوير الصناعة المصرية — ابدأ
name.en: National Initiative for the Development of Egyptian Industry — EBDA

source.acquisition_method: Direct fetch of the SVG asset shipped by the official EBDA site. The SVG wraps a base64 PNG payload at 1182x607; that payload was extracted and re-canvased to the 1600x1000 spec.

added_clients.notes: Highest-confidence entry in the delta — asset comes straight from the entity's official website. No manual reconstruction.

source.acquisition_method: Header logo asset served from the company's WordPress instance. Full-color variant (dark navy wordmark + gold building/sun icon) was used; the site also ships a white-on-transparent variant.

added_clients.notes: The registry's owner-column token was 'الشرق' (ambiguous). This is the most likely match — an Egyptian contractor operating under that exact Arabic name with a live official site. Confirm with the client's source document before publication.

source.acquisition_method: Profile logo of the company's official Facebook page, retrieved via the page's og:image meta tag at 720x720. No other official web presence found.

added_clients.notes: Registry token was 'الزاهي' (ambiguous). Match rationale: only Egyptian construction/group entity found under that exact Arabic wordmark. Confirm identity match with the client's source document before publication.

source.acquisition_method: Profile logo of the company's official Facebook page, retrieved via the page's og:image meta tag at 720x720. Original background was near-white; removed via alpha flood-fill during standardization.

added_clients.notes: Registry token was 'النوبي' (ambiguous). Match rationale: only Egyptian construction group found under that exact Arabic wordmark. Confirm identity match with the client's source document before publication.

identity_status.verified_official: identity confirmed via the entity's own official website
identity_status.plausible_candidate_from_official_page: the asset is the official brand file of a real, live entity; what is unconfirmed is whether this entity is the one the client meant by the ambiguous registry token

logo_status.official_source: asset was fetched directly from the entity's official website
logo_status.official_social_source: asset was fetched from the entity's verified/official social page (used only when no dedicated website ships a logo asset)

sensitivity.standard: no restrictions beyond normal brand usage — all four delta entries are standard-sensitivity

integration.drop_in: Copy all 8 files into your existing logos/ directory alongside the v1 pack. No filename collisions — numbering starts at 14 to continue the v1 sequence (01-13).
